name: LINGOreligion
purpose: A fictional cultural layer within the Lingo Legacy universe centered on identity, belonging, acceptance, unity, elevation, and becoming.
creed: We don’t judge. We don’t discriminate. We don’t divide. Everyone’s accepted. Everyone can become.
manifesto: LINGOreligion is the culture of becoming. No judgment. No discrimination. No limits. Step into the LINGO world and discover a universe built around acceptance, elevation, unity, transformation, and belonging.
